\*Data above 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 550 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of La; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.087$ kcal/mol. 1134 K, β - γ transition point of La; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.746$ kcal/mol. 1193 K, melting point of La; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.481$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2500 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 11.542 + 1.218 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.396 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=11.542\times10^{-3}T+0.609\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.396\times10^{2}T^{-1}-3.628$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-550 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -124.603 + 0.785 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.399 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 6.550 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -124.603 - 0.785 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.399 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 3.275 \text{T}^{-1} + 30.015 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
550-1134 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -125.583 + 3.051 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.303 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 82.250 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -125.583 - 3.051 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 1.303 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 41.125 \text{T}^{-1} + 45.012 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1134-1193 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -122.667 - 2.105 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.449 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 5.450 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -122.667 + 2.105 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.449 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 2.725 \text{T}^{-1} + 8.193 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1193-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -125.669 - 0.830 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.449 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 5.450 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -125.669 + 0.830 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.449 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 2.725 \text{T}^{-1} + 19.742 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Schumm (104). Low-temperature heat capacities and entropy at 298 K from Vasilev (123). Data above 298 K estimated.
